strata_analysis.subterranean_bedrock: Dalradian Supergroup metamorphic schist and Caledonian intrusive granites overlain by Quaternary fluvioglacial sands, gravels, and peat podzols of the Strathspey basin.
strata_analysis.ground_plane: Compacted gravel and crushed aggregate farm tracks, graded dirt airstrip runway/access lanes, improved pastoral grass fields, drainage ditches, and rough moorland verges.

built_massing_envelope.structural_typology: Scottish Highland agricultural and estate farmstead complex with steel-portal frame barns, corrugated metal sheet cladding, pitched profile roofing, and masonry ancillary outbuildings.
rectification_targets: Plumb warped vertical walls of the large agricultural storage sheds
Sharpen corrugated roof pitches, gables, and ridge lines
Rectify low-rise outbuilding eaves and planar ground-contact margins

strata_analysis.landscape_micro_ecology: Highland Strathspey pastoral meadows, patches of semi-natural Scots pine (Pinus sylvestris), birch scrub (Betula pendula), gorse (Ulex europaeus), and background heather-clad (Calluna vulgaris) rolling hills.
strata_analysis.atmosphere_optics: Temperate Scottish Highland daylight, dynamic broken stratocumulus clouds producing shifting light patterns, diffuse daylight (~5500K), clear crisp atmospheric visibility across the glen.

properties.rectification_note: Planarize steel shed facades, correct low-pitch corrugated gable roofs, and define gravel yard perimeter.
